name: ComplianceAsCode/content
description: Security automation content in SCAP, Bash, Ansible, and other formats for auditing and compliance of Linux systems (RHEL, Fedora, Ubuntu, Debian) against frameworks like NIST 800-53, CIS Benchmarks, and PCI DSS.
score_rationale: Mature security automation content repository with 2.7k stars and 42k+ commits, actively maintained through March 2026, used as the foundation for government and enterprise Linux compliance.
